name: Jiangsu King's Luck Brewery Joint-Stock Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1996 and based in Huai'an, China, Jiangsu King's Luck Brewery Joint-Stock Co., Ltd. is involved in the manufacturing and distribution of alcoholic beverages. The company's product line, which includes both liquor and wine, is primarily marketed under the recognized brand names of Gaogou, Jinshiyuan, and Guoyuan.
